key_highlights: ASX set to plunge tracking Wall Street correction led by sharp tech and AI selloffs.
Australian equity benchmark wiped $169B over the prior week amidst severe broad-market risk-off.
Cumulative RBA rate hikes escalate mortgage defaults and trigger aggressive Sydney housing price declines.
Retail distress deepens with David Jones cutting 1,700 jobs as consumer discretionary spending contracts.
AUD weakness persists amidst global risk aversion and mounting domestic economic headwinds.

sectors.trend: Severe global multiple contraction in AI and high-beta tech equities spilling over into local names.
sectors.implications: Downside repricing across ASX tech growth plays; elevated volatility in data center and AI-levered stocks.

sectors.trend: Mounting mortgage stress and rapid property value erosion challenging bank asset quality.
sectors.implications: Margin compression and rising bad debt provisioning for major commercial lenders.

sectors.trend: Bifurcation between gold/critical mineral exploration momentum and broader commodity demand pressures.
sectors.implications: Junior gold and rare-earth explorers outperforming while base metals face currency and macro headwinds.

sectors.trend: Acute consumer pullback evidenced by department store restructuring and workforce reductions.
sectors.implications: Underperformance in high-ticket discretionary retail; market share consolidation toward discount operators.

sectors.trend: Heightened scrutiny on transition costs, domestic energy security, and major project viability.
sectors.implications: Capital discipline favored over speculative greenfield infrastructure and disputed transition projects.

key_themes: Global tech valuation de-rating dragging Australian equity markets lower.
Monetary tightening lag effects precipitating housing downturn and consumer exhaustion.
Safe-haven rotation into gold and domestic critical mineral assets.
Currency depreciation against USD increasing imported inflation risks.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight high-LTV exposed major banks; favor lenders with diversified corporate loan books.
Hedge growth exposures using broad-market index puts or reduce exposure to high PE multiples.
Avoid residential property developers and direct consumer-facing building material suppliers.
Increase allocation to USD-earning resource exporters and offshore healthcare franchises.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold producers and near-term restarts as counter-cyclical hedges.
opportunities.rationale: Strong domestic gold pricing and risk-off sentiment drive margin expansion for low-cost producers.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate USD-earning defensive global leaders on market pullbacks.
opportunities.rationale: CSL and BHP offer revenue insulation against AUD depreciation and domestic consumer slowdown.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim exposure to ASX major retail banks.
defensive_moves.rationale: Escalating mortgage stress and Sydney house price declines pose asset quality and NIM risks.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce holdings in high-beta tech and cyclical consumer discretionary equities.
defensive_moves.rationale: Wall Street correction and severe household budget contraction heighten earnings downgrade risks.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish bias over 1–3 months as ASX 200 absorbs global equity corrections, credit strain, and retail headwinds.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautious recovery over 6–12 months supported by eventual RBA policy easing, resource exports, and currency-driven offshore earnings.
key_catalysts: RBA Board interest rate statement and inflation commentary
Quarterly Australian CPI and retail trade data releases
US FOMC policy guidance and Wall Street tech sector stabilization
China commodity demand indicators and iron ore spot pricing

AUD/USD exchange rate trajectory and imported cost pressures
Australian 30+ day mortgage arrears and Sydney auction clearance rates
Gold and rare earths capital-raising activity across ASX junior miners
